keyPhrases.text: There were pleasures to be had
first half of Hairspray dragged a bit
performers weren't quite all on the same page
he couldn't quite find the character
all 58 cameras seemed to be pointing in the wrong direction

reasoning: Mixed review that acknowledges the production's ambitions and several strong elements (Chenoweth/Cameron pairing, Fierstein/Short performances, improved production values) but also notes significant issues with pacing, performer cohesion, and technical execution. Falls in the 3/5 star range with both substantive praise and meaningful criticisms.
